theorem isConfEnt_stamp (t li : w64) (k : Nat) (e : EntryM) : IsConfEnt (stamp t li k e) ↔ IsConfEnt
    e

def CfgSingle (c : CfgM) (id : w64) : Prop :=
  c.incoming = {id} ∧ c.outgoing = ∅

theorem JQuorum_intersect {c : CfgM} (hi : c.incoming ≠ ∅) {q1 q2 : GSet w64} (h1 : JQuorum c q1)
    (h2 : JQuorum c q2) : ∃ x, x ∈ q1 ∧ x ∈ q2

theorem confCount_take_succ (l : List EntryM) (k : Nat) : confCount (List.take (k + 1) l) =
    confCount (List.take k l) + if IsConfPos l k then 1 else 0

theorem JQuorum_single {c : CfgM} {id : w64} (h : CfgSingle c id) : JQuorum c {id}

def CfgM.simple (cfg lrn : GSet w64) : CfgM :=
  { incoming := cfg, outgoing := ∅, learners := lrn, learnersNext := ∅, autoLeave := false }

theorem confCount_take_mono (l : List EntryM) {i j : Nat} (h : i ≤ j) : confCount (List.take i l) ≤
    confCount (List.take j l)

theorem cfgSingle_iff (c : CfgM) (id : w64) : CfgSingle c id ↔ id ∈ c.incoming ∧ GMap.size
    c.incoming = 1 ∧ GMap.size c.outgoing = 0

def JQuorum (c : CfgM) (q : GSet w64) : Prop :=
  MajQ c.incoming q ∧ MajQ c.outgoing q

def IsConfPos (l : List EntryM) (k : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∃ e, l[k]? = some e ∧ IsConfEnt e

theorem confCount_take_agree {l l' : List EntryM} {m k : Nat} (h : List.take m l' = List.take m l)
    (hk : k ≤ m) : confCount (List.take k l') = confCount (List.take k l)

theorem confCount_cons (e : EntryM) (l : List EntryM) : confCount (e :: l) = confCount l + if
    IsConfEnt e then 1 else 0

theorem ConfI1_snoc {l : List EntryM} {c : Nat} {e : EntryM} (h : ConfI1 l c) (he : ¬IsConfEnt e) :
    ConfI1 (l ++ [e]) c

def JQuorumAcked (c : CfgM) (f : w64 → w64) (N : w64) : Prop :=
  ∃ Q, JQuorum c Q ∧ ∀ (v : w64), v ∈ Q → uint.Z N ≤ uint.Z (f v)

theorem CfgM.voters_simple (cfg lrn : GSet w64) : (CfgM.simple cfg lrn).voters = cfg

theorem QOverlap.refl {c : CfgM} (hi : c.incoming ≠ ∅) : QOverlap c c

theorem MajQ_empty (q : GSet w64) : MajQ ∅ q

theorem CfgM.voters_of_out {c : CfgM} (h : c.outgoing = ∅) : c.voters = c.incoming

def CfgM.voters (c : CfgM) : GSet w64 :=
  c.incoming ∪ c.outgoing

theorem exists_confPos (l : List EntryM) (a j : Nat) (h : j < confCount (List.take a l)) : ∃ k, k <
    a ∧ IsConfPos l k ∧ confCount (List.take k l) = j

theorem confPos_ge_of_count (l : List EntryM) {a k : Nat} (hk : IsConfPos l k) (hc : confCount
    (List.take a l) ≤ confCount (List.take k l)) : a ≤ k

def confCount (l : List EntryM) : Nat :=
  List.countP (fun e => decide (IsConfEnt e)) l

def QOverlap (c1 c2 : CfgM) : Prop :=
  ∀ (q1 q2 : GSet w64), JQuorum c1 q1 → JQuorum c2 q2 → ∃ x, x ∈ q1 ∧ x ∈ q2

theorem two_le_confCount {l : List EntryM} {k1 k2 : Nat} {e1 e2 : EntryM} (hlt : k1 < k2) (h1 :
    l[k1]? = some e1) (h2 : l[k2]? = some e2) (c1 : IsConfEnt e1) (c2 : IsConfEnt e2) : 2 ≤
    confCount l

theorem confPos_lt_of_count (l : List EntryM) {k1 k2 : Nat} (hc : confCount (List.take k1 l) <
    confCount (List.take k2 l)) : k1 < k2

def IsConfPos.dec (l : List EntryM) (k : Nat) : Decidable (IsConfPos l k) :=
  match h : l[k]? with
  | some e => if hc : IsConfEnt e then isTrue ⋯ else isFalse ⋯
  | none => isFalse ⋯

inductive StepC (c : CfgM) (id : w64) (B : Int) : PState → List Msg → PState → Prop
  | StepC.refl {c : CfgM} {id : w64} {B : Int} (s : PState) : StepC c id B s [] s
  | StepC.trans {c : CfgM} {id : w64} {B : Int} (s₀ : PState) (r₁ : List Msg) (s₁ : PState) (r₂ :
      List Msg) (s₂ : PState) : StepC c id B s₀ r₁ s₁ → StepC c id B s₁ r₂ s₂ → StepC c id B s₀ (r₁
      ++ r₂) s₂
  | StepC.higherTerm {c : CfgM} {id : w64} {B : Int} (m : Msg) (s : PState) : uint.Z s.term < uint.Z
      m.term → m.dst = id → (fromLeader m.ty = true → m.src ≠ id) → StepC c id B s [m]
      (pbecomeFollower s m.term (if fromLeader m.ty = true then m.src else W64 0))
  | StepC.campaign {c : CfgM} {id : w64} {B : Int} (s : PState) (peers : List w64) (cl : List w8) :
      s.role ≠ Role.leader → id ∈ c.voters → uint.Z s.term + 1 < 2 ^ 64 → peers.Perm (elements
      (c.voters \ {id})) → StepC c id B s [] (psendMsgs (pbecomeCandidate id s) ([Msg.plain
      MsgType.voteResp id id (pbecomeCandidate id s).term false] ++ List.map (fun dst => pvoteReq id
      dst (pbecomeCandidate id s).term (plogLast s.base s.log) cl) peers))
  | StepC.grantVote {c : CfgM} {id : w64} {B : Int} (m : Msg) (s : PState) : m.ty = MsgType.vote →
      m.dst = id → m.src ≠ W64 0 → m.term = s.term → PCanVote s m.src → plogUpToDate s.base s.log {
      term' := m.logterm, index' := m.index } = true → StepC c id B s [m] (psendMsgs { term :=
      s.term, vote := m.src, lead := s.lead, role := s.role, votes := s.votes, outbox := s.outbox,
      base := s.base, log := s.log, commit := s.commit, matched := s.matched, rd := s.rd }
      [Msg.plain MsgType.voteResp id m.src s.term false])
  | StepC.rejectVote {c : CfgM} {id : w64} {B : Int} (m : Msg) (s : PState) : m.ty = MsgType.vote →
      m.dst = id → StepC c id B s [m] (psendMsgs s [Msg.plain MsgType.voteResp id m.src s.term
      true])
  | StepC.recordVote {c : CfgM} {id : w64} {B : Int} (m : Msg) (s : PState) : m.ty =
      MsgType.voteResp → m.dst = id → m.term = s.term → s.role = Role.candidate → StepC c id B s [m]
      { term := s.term, vote := s.vote, lead := s.lead, role := s.role, votes := recordVote s.votes
      m.src !m.reject, outbox := s.outbox, base := s.base, log := s.log, commit := s.commit, matched
      := s.matched, rd := s.rd }
  | StepC.win {c : CfgM} {id : w64} {B : Int} (s : PState) (mt : GMap w64 w64) (ms : List Msg) :
      s.role = Role.candidate → JQuorum c (granted s.votes) → plogLastIndexZ s.base s.log + 1 ≤ B →
      LeaderMatchOk id s mt → (∀ (m : Msg), m ∈ ms → ReplOk id (pwinState id s mt) m) → (∀ (m :
      Msg), m ∈ ms → m.ty = MsgType.snap → m.dst ∈ c.voters ∪ c.learners) → StepC c id B s []
      (psendMsgs (pwinState id s mt) ([pselfAck id (pwinState id s mt)] ++ ms))
  | StepC.lose {c : CfgM} {id : w64} {B : Int} (s : PState) : s.role = Role.candidate → JLost c
      s.votes → StepC c id B s [] (pbecomeFollower s s.term (W64 0))
  | StepC.drain {c : CfgM} {id : w64} {B : Int} (s : PState) (o' : List Msg) : o'.Subperm s.outbox →
      StepC c id B s [] { term := s.term, vote := s.vote, lead := s.lead, role := s.role, votes :=
      s.votes, outbox := o', base := s.base, log := s.log, commit := s.commit, matched := s.matched,
      rd := s.rd }
  | StepC.appAccept {c : CfgM} {id : w64} {B : Int} (m : Msg) (s : PState) (lastnewi : w64) (es' :
      List EntryM) : m.ty = MsgType.app → m.dst = id → m.src ≠ id → m.term = s.term → s.role ≠
      Role.leader → uint.Z s.commit ≤ uint.Z m.index → plogMaybeAppend s.base s.log { term' :=
      m.logterm, index' := m.index } m.entries = some (lastnewi, es') → plogFindConflict s.base
      s.log m.entries = W64 0 ∨ uint.Z s.commit < uint.Z (plogFindConflict s.base s.log m.entries) →
      StepC c id B s [m] (psendMsgs (let __src := padoptLeader s m.src; { term := __src.term, vote
      := __src.vote, lead := __src.lead, role := __src.role, votes := __src.votes, outbox :=
      __src.outbox, base := __src.base, log := es', commit

theorem not_isConfEnt_zero : ¬IsConfEnt (zero_val EntryM)

theorem ConfI1_of_drop {l : List EntryM} {a : Nat} (h : confCount (List.drop a l) ≤ 1) : ConfI1 l a

def ConfI1 (l : List EntryM) (c : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∀ (k1 k2 : Nat) (e1 e2 : EntryM), k1 < k2 → l[k1]? = some e1 → l[k2]? = some e2 → IsConfEnt e1 → IsConfEnt e2 → k1 < c

theorem confCount_pos {l : List EntryM} {k : Nat} {e : EntryM} (h : l[k]? = some e) (hc : IsConfEnt
    e) : 0 < confCount l

theorem IsConfPos_of_take {l l' : List EntryM} {m k : Nat} (h : List.take m l' = List.take m l) (hk
    : k < m) (hp : IsConfPos l k) : IsConfPos l' k

theorem QOverlap.symm {c1 c2 : CfgM} (h : QOverlap c1 c2) : QOverlap c2 c1

theorem far_newer {F F0 : List EntryM} {a k : Nat} (hI1 : ConfI1 F a) (hag : List.take k F =
    List.take k F0) (hc : confCount (List.take a F) + 2 ≤ confCount (List.take k F0)) : False

theorem JQuorum_of_out {c : CfgM} (hi : c.incoming ≠ ∅) (ho : c.outgoing = ∅) (q : GSet w64) :
    JQuorum c q ↔ IsQuorum c.incoming q

structure CfgM : Type where
  incoming : GSet w64
  outgoing : GSet w64
  learners : GSet w64
  learnersNext : GSet w64
  autoLeave : Bool

theorem JQuorum_incoming {c : CfgM} {q : GSet w64} (hi : c.incoming ≠ ∅) (h : JQuorum c q) :
    IsQuorum c.incoming q

theorem far_older {F F0 : List EntryM} {k k2 : Nat} (hI1 : ConfI1 F0 k) (hag : List.take (k2 + 1) F0
    = List.take (k2 + 1) F) (hp2 : IsConfPos F k2) (hc : confCount (List.take k2 F) = confCount
    (List.take k F0) + 1) : False

def MajQ (s q : GSet w64) : Prop :=
  s = ∅ ∨ IsQuorum s q

def AppCommitEq (s : PState) (m : Msg) : Prop :=
  m.ty = MsgType.app → m.commit = s.commit

theorem confCount_take_eq_of_drop {l : List EntryM} {a k : Nat} (h : confCount (List.drop a l) ≤ 1)
    (hk : IsConfPos l k) (hak : a ≤ k) : confCount (List.take k l) = confCount (List.take a l)

theorem confCount_append (l1 l2 : List EntryM) : confCount (l1 ++ l2) = confCount l1 + confCount l2

def JLost (c : CfgM) (votes : GMap w64 Bool) : Prop :=
  ¬MajQ c.incoming (c.incoming \ rejected votes) ∨ ¬MajQ c.outgoing (c.outgoing \ rejected votes)

def CfgM.joint (c : CfgM) : Bool :=
  decide (0 < GMap.size c.outgoing)

theorem MajQ_of_ne {s : GSet w64} (q : GSet w64) (h : s ≠ ∅) : MajQ s q ↔ IsQuorum s q
